source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

parts.effect:
If the unit is one of your **HALO OVERRIDE** units, it takes D3 [mortal wounds](vsdata:core-rule/mortal-wounds). Pick an [Override ability](vsdata:ability/adeptus-mechanicus.haloscreed-battle-clade.noospheric-transference); it is active for the unit until [your next Command phase](vsdata:core-rule/command-phase).

**Designer's Note**: so a unit with **HALO OVERRIDE** can have several Override abilities active at once, at the cost of mortal wounds. A unit without **HALO OVERRIDE** instead has only the picked Override ability until your next Command phase, and benefits from no other active Override abilities.

data.summary:

**Target:** An **ADEPTUS MECHANICUS** unit of yours.

Pick an [Override ability](vsdata:ability/adeptus-mechanicus.haloscreed-battle-clade.noospheric-transference); it is active for the unit until [your next Command phase](vsdata:core-rule/command-phase).

**Designer's Note**: so a unit with **HALO OVERRIDE** can have several Override abilities active at once, at the cost of mortal wounds. A unit without **HALO OVERRIDE** instead has only the picked Override ability until your next Command phase, and benefits from no other active Override abilities.
